skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role and scope of government intervention in a market economy.
Analyze the four basic roles of government in a market economy: resource allocation, income redistribution, macroeconomic stability, and national representation.
Evaluate the effectiveness of government policies in addressing market failures and social equity issues.
Understand the research object, content, and methods of public economics.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze real-world scenarios related to government roles in different economic and social contexts.
Foster self-learning and research skills to continuously accumulate knowledge and adapt to changing work environments.
Understand professional ethics and social responsibility in policy-making, monitoring, and evaluation.
Participate actively in class discussions and seminars.
Solve problems related to public economics and government intervention.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and prepare for exams.
